# Launch Screen Assets

These launch assets are generated by flutter_native_splash. Update the flutter_native_splash configuration in the repository-root pubspec.yaml and its referenced branding assets, then run from the repository root:

```sh
fvm dart run flutter_native_splash:create
```

Review the generated Android and iOS changes. Direct edits in Xcode may be overwritten by regeneration. Keep the native splash consistent with lib/screens/launch_splash_overlay.dart and verify the transition on a device or simulator.
